title: Neutrality and independence
criterion: Static check over the core finds no deny-listed domain term and no import of apg, a pack or a consumer; the same check fails on a planted term and on a planted import.

title: Portability
criterion: Adding the synthetic second pack changes no core file (hashes identical before and after) and both packs run through the same core code.

title: Pack validation
criterion: A malformed pack, a pack with unknown keys or executable content, a pack that tries to override a core invariant, a pack with an unsupported schema or core version and a pack with a wrong hash pin are each refused with the stated code.
requirement_ids: MIE-R-15; MIE-R-28; MIE-R-29; MIE-R-30; MIE-R-31; MIE-R-32

title: Observation integrity
criterion: An observation missing source, licence, unit, market, class, basis or date is rejected; only licensed data is used; no float, future-dated, retrieved-before-as_of or invented gap value exists; unlicensed and unknown-licence data is never used; equivalence exists only where a pack declares it; duplicates are idempotent.
requirement_ids: MIE-R-05; MIE-R-06; MIE-R-07; MIE-R-08; MIE-R-09; MIE-R-10; MIE-R-11; MIE-R-13

title: Explicit freshness and parameters
criterion: A missing freshness limit or signal parameter stops that assessment with the stated reason; exactly-at-limit is fresh and one day past is stale; no default exists.

title: Allowed outcomes
criterion: The timing result returns only outcomes allowed for the pack's allowed intentions; the APG pack cannot produce any SELL-side outcome and refuses a SELL intention.

title: Gaps and advisory records
criterion: Every missing input appears as an evidence gap and is never counted as zero; every result discloses evidence, ages, uncertainty, qualification and rule; every result states that it commits nothing and a human decides.

title: Reproducibility
criterion: A result replays byte-identically from its pinned inputs, core version and pack version using stored evidence; missing evidence is reported; a changed version yields a drift report and leaves the original intact; the core reads no clock, network or environment.

title: Tenant isolation
criterion: Another tenant's data is indistinguishable from missing data; payload tenant fields are refused; invalid contexts are refused on every operation; returned values are independent copies.

title: Frozen baselines
criterion: M6 and the whole existing APG suite pass unchanged on the tree that contains the core; locked sections, CR-09, the RTM and all preserved release hashes are unchanged.

title: Sabotage proof
criterion: Every catalogued mutant is caught by at least one named test; the test inventory matches the register.

title: Honest reporting
criterion: The report separates builder-run from independently verified results, carries exact hashes, defects and limitations, and makes no readiness or market-validity claim.

title: Isolation gate
criterion: No APG finding or recommendation imports or consumes the core; APG outputs are byte-identical with and without the core; no consumer adapter is wired.

title: Pack immutability and approval
criterion: Same (id, version) with different bytes is refused; identical re-publication is a no-op; withdrawal blocks new assessments but not replay; activation needs a verified owner approval reference and pins the hash.

title: Scenarios and forecasts stay separate
criterion: Scenarios are caller-supplied and labelled ASSUMPTION; none is generated from history; no operation reads, writes or references an approved forecast; the four evidence groups are never merged.

title: Observed facts, no prediction, direction-neutral
criterion: Signals state observed facts with evidence and a descriptive basis; the schema has no forecast-type field; mirrored histories give mirrored signals; the vocabulary is closed.

title: Stale, conflicting and missing evidence
criterion: Conflicts are reported and never chosen; stale or expired evidence qualifies the result; worlds that are entirely stale, conflicting, unlicensed or empty produce NOT_ASSESSED, never an outcome from nothing.

title: Fail closed
criterion: Audit-sink failure, store failure, unexpected exceptions, exceeded or unconfigured limits and hostile text each give a typed error with no result and no state change.

title: Service boundary
criterion: describe() reports all versions; every operation and outbound port is defined with a contract and a reference implementation; the adapter-side ObservationSourcePort has a contract suite and a test double and is not called by the core; MarketFeedPort-style input maps through a feed adapter and submit_observations with MF-01..13 analogues; the audit append and audit query contracts are separate.
requirement_ids: MIE-R-03; MIE-R-44; MIE-R-45; MIE-R-46; MIE-R-47; MIE-R-48

title: No builder-invented values
criterion: No production pack carries a threshold, limit, price path, parameter or rule supplied by the builder; test values are flagged TEST-ONLY; an incomplete pack yields NOT_ASSESSED.

title: Change request discipline
criterion: The Section 08 change request exists as an unnumbered DRAFT, offers its options, preserves the four safeguards, edits no locked file; the decision profile of the APG pack is CONTEXT_ONLY until the owner decides.

title: Deterministic decision table
criterion: Rules are evaluated in order with first match winning; the predicate language is closed; no table and no match give the stated NOT_ASSESSED reasons; assumption-based outcomes are labelled.

title: Audit contract coherence
criterion: list_audit reads through AuditQueryPort and appends one access event that is not in its own result and cannot recurse; every operation with a verified context audits before it commits and fails closed with AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE; a context failure produces the context error and no tenant event; every operation's declared error list contains the common failures; the register and the specification agree.

title: Signal-influence safeguard for every outcome
criterion: Every rule that uses a market-signal predicate and every downstream rule (a rule with a signal-influenced rule earlier in the table, whatever that earlier rule's configured outcome) is an owner-assumption rule with owner reference and statement, whatever its own configured outcome (NOT_ASSESSED included); otherwise the pack is refused; every result discloses DIRECT, PRECEDENCE or NONE by the one definition of MIE-R-63; DIRECT and PRECEDENCE outcomes are labelled assumption-based with owner reference and statement; CONTEXT_ONLY packs never let a signal influence an outcome.

title: Value domains and movement mathematics
criterion: Every unit declares its value domain and out-of-domain values are rejected; movement is exact and direction-safe for negative, zero and sign-crossing values under both bases; a zero base gives ZERO_BASE under RELATIVE; crosses_zero is stated; negating a SIGNED series mirrors direction and ratio; no basis or threshold is assumed.

title: Observation-feed flow
criterion: The core never calls ObservationSourcePort or any feed and retrieves nothing during assessment; the ingestion driver and feed adapter retrieve, map and submit; the core alone validates every item at submit_observations; feed failures stay adapter-side and appear only as evidence gaps; retries are idempotent; a feed-asserted licence status never grants use; M6 is not changed.

title: Specification-approval dispositions
criterion: The nine specification-approval questions each carry a disposition, justification, basis, consequence of the alternative, owner, decision still needed and a status; none is recorded as decided by the builder; product-owner-owned questions show the product-owner decision still required.

title: Revision discipline
criterion: The earlier package is preserved unchanged and its hash re-verified; the change log maps every audit point to the rows changed; every added or revised row is tagged.

title: Precedence loophole closed; pack check and result contract consistent
criterion: A signal-influenced rule configured NOT_ASSESSED whose predicate does not match, followed by a later rule under OBSERVED_EVIDENCE_ONLY that attempts ACT_NOW or any other outcome (NOT_ASSESSED included), is refused with PACK_RULE_POLICY_VIOLATION by validate_pack and register_pack; nothing is stored, the pack cannot be activated, and no PRECEDENCE result can be emitted from it. The same sequence with every rule from the first signal-influenced rule onward carrying OWNER_ASSUMPTION, an owner reference and an assumption statement is accepted and yields DIRECT, PRECEDENCE or NONE exactly as the position of the fired rule requires; NO_RULE_MATCHED and NO_TABLE give class NONE; an unlabelled DIRECT or PRECEDENCE result is never emitted and fails closed.

title: Explicit implementation blockers
criterion: The blockers register lists BLK-01 (audit append and state commit atomicity), BLK-02 (M6 mapping not derived) and BLK-03 (Section 08 cascade assessment unfinished), each open and blocking implementation authorisation, none resolved, none decided by the builder; the specification and README state them and state that no revision is closed or implementation-ready.
